Stance grounded confident. Looking directly at camera with educational empathic expression - the look of "let me explain something important you didn't know".
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'devi sapere una cosa'" - left eyebrow micro-raised 3mm, mouth slight serious half-smile right corner up 2mm, eyes direct camera with calm authority. Subtle chin tilt down 1° for credible explanation tone.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical equivalent, eye level, distance 105cm.
Light: single soft window light camera-left at 45°, 5100K neutral.
Aesthetic: modern Italian Instagram coach 2026 educational style. NOT cinematic editorial.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions.
Color grading: neutral + 3% warmth max.
Composition: subject center frame chest up, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
